definitions.explanation: Going to the furthest possible point; far from moderate or average.

examples.japanese: {極端的|きょくたんてき}な{考|かんが}え{方|かた}は{避|さ}けた{方|ほう}がいい。
examples.english: It's better to avoid extreme ways of thinking.

examples.japanese: {極端的|きょくたんてき}な{例|れい}を{挙|あ}げてみよう。
examples.english: Let me give an extreme example.

examples.japanese: {極端的|きょくたんてき}に{言|い}えば、{失敗|しっぱい}だった。
examples.english: Put extremely, it was a failure.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
Formed from {極端|きょくたん} (extreme) + 的 (suffix making na-adjectives).

ADVERBIAL FORM:
{極端的|きょくたんてき}に: extremely, radically

NOTE:
The base word {極端|きょくたん} is also commonly used on its own as a na-adjective or in the adverbial form {極端|きょくたん}に.
